I have farmed for over forty years and I know that beans do not need chemical fertilizer because they feed themselves from the air. I will put manure on this plot because it is mine and I want to keep the soil strong, and I will use my own saved seed since it is free and I trust it. I will spray when the flowers come because the pod borer always attacks my cowpea if I do not. My family will work about forty-five days on this plot between planting, weeding, and harvesting, and I will not pay for hired labor because we can manage ourselves.
